editorial.blurb: RPM Seafood delivers exceptional ocean-to-table cuisine with a warm, attentive service that makes every occasion feel celebrated.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early—people line up at noon when doors open. Request a river view table and ask your server (like Clint) for recommendations on the grilled preparations, which are often cooked tableside.
signatureDishes: Grilled Seafood mix of grilled octopus and prawn

topDishes.note: Cooked to perfection with great depth of flavor, a waiter favorite

topDishes.dish: Grilled Seafood mix of grilled octopus and prawn

topDishes.note: Out of this world appetizer that exceeded expectations
